# ROB-003: Unknown methods get -32601 Method not found

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| error | both eras, stdio, http | [2026-07-28/basic/transports/streamable-http#protocol-version-header](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/transports/streamable-http#protocol-version-header) |

Calls a method no server implements (mcpprobe/no-such-method). On Streamable HTTP in the 2026-07-28 era the server MUST respond with 404 Not Found and a JSON-RPC error with code -32601. On stdio, and in initialize-era sessions, every request MUST get a response under JSON-RPC 2.0 (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/index#messages), and -32601 is the code JSON-RPC defines for a method that does not exist; the error must echo the request id. Runs once per server.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain ROB-003`. To leave it out of a run, add `"ROB-003"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
